info.title: GlobalShelfBD API
info.description:
E-commerce backend with JWT authentication and permission-based access control.

**How to test protected routes:**
1. Call `/api/auth/login` (the Admin email and password are in `.env`: `ADMIN_EMAIL`, `ADMIN_PASSWORD`)
2. Copy `data.accessToken` from the response
3. Click **Authorize** (top right) and paste the token

Access token expires in 15 minutes. Use `/api/auth/refresh-token` to get a new one.

**Response format:** every API returns `{ success, message, data }`. Errors return `{ success: false, message }`.

**Status codes:** 200 OK, 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized (not logged in / bad token), 403 Forbidden (no permission / inactive), 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict (duplicate / role in use), 429 Too Many Requests, 500 Internal Server Error.

get.description: Any logged-in user can call this. `menu` lists the admin dashboard pages this user may open (empty for customers). Use `permissions` on the frontend to show or hide buttons. The backend still checks every API.

put.summary: Edit my profile (name, phone, avatar, email)
put.description:
Any logged-in user, own account only.

- Changing **email** needs `currentPassword`
- The **password is never changed here**. To change it use forgot-password: an OTP is emailed, then set a new password with it
- Role and status in the body are ignored

Returns the same data as GET /api/auth/me.

401.description: Not logged in, or wrong current password when changing email

example.message: Current password is incorrect

409.description: Email already used by another account

example.message: This email is already used by another account

post.summary: Step 1: Email a 6-digit password reset OTP
post.description:
Sends a 6-digit code to the email (from no-reply@globalshelfbd.com). The code expires in 10 minutes. A new code can be requested after 60 seconds (429 before that).

The same message is returned whether or not the email exists.

**Development only:** data.devOnly.otp contains the code so you can test in Swagger. In production the code is only in the email.

message.example: If an account exists with this email, an OTP has been sent

example.message: Please wait 45 seconds before requesting a new OTP
Email could not be sent, please try again later

post.description:
**Permission:** `roles.create`

You can only give a new role permissions that you have yourself. Role names are unique (case-insensitive). Logs `ROLE_CREATED` and `PERMISSION_ASSIGNED`.

get.summary: List all roles with user and permission counts
get.description: **Permission:** `roles.view`

get.summary: Get a role with its permissions and user count
get.description: **Permission:** `roles.view`

put.description:
**Permission:** `roles.update`

All fields are optional. `permissions` **replaces** the role's permission list.

Rules:
- You cannot edit your own role
- You cannot edit a role that has permissions you do not have
- You can only grant permissions you have
- Protected roles (Admin, Customer) cannot be renamed
- Admin role permissions cannot be changed (always all)

Logs `ROLE_UPDATED`, `PERMISSION_ASSIGNED`, `PERMISSION_REMOVED`.

delete.description:
**Permission:** `roles.delete`

Admin and Customer cannot be deleted. A role that still has users cannot be deleted (409): move those users to another active role first. Logs `ROLE_DELETED`.

example.message: Role deleted successfully
Cannot delete role: 3 user(s) still have this role. Assign them to another active role first

patch.description:
**Permission:** `roles.status`

Users with an INACTIVE role lose all permissions until it is activated again, and the role cannot be assigned. Admin and Customer cannot be deactivated. Logs `ROLE_STATUS_CHANGED`.

get.description: **Permission:** `users.view`

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search in full name and email

post.summary: Create a user with a role (e.g. staff accounts)
post.description:
**Permission:** `users.create`

If `roleId` is omitted the user gets the Customer role. You can only assign an ACTIVE role whose permissions you have. Logs `USER_CREATED`.

get.description: **Permission:** `users.view`

delete.description:
**Permission:** `users.delete`

You cannot delete yourself, a user with permissions you do not have, or the last active Admin. Logs `USER_DELETED`.

example.message: User deleted successfully

put.description:
**Permission:** `users.update`

You cannot edit yourself here (use PUT /api/auth/me) or a user who has permissions you do not have. Passwords are never set here. Logs `USER_UPDATED`.

patch.description:
**Permission:** `users.changeRole`

The backend checks:
- You are logged in and have `users.changeRole`
- You are not changing your own role
- The target user has no permissions you lack (e.g. a Manager cannot change an Admin)
- The new role exists and is ACTIVE
- The new role has no permissions you lack (no privilege escalation)
- The last active Admin cannot be demoted

Logs `USER_ROLE_CHANGED`.

**Permission:** `users.update`

Inactive users cannot log in, and their existing tokens stop working immediately. Logs `USER_STATUS_CHANGED`.

get.summary: List all permissions grouped by module
get.description:
**Permission:** `permissions.view`

Permissions are defined in code (`config/permissions.js`) and are read-only through the API. Use the names from here in the role `permissions` array.

example.message: Permissions fetched successfully

post.summary: Upload images and get their URLs
post.description:
**Permission:** any of `products.create`, `products.update`, `categories.create`, `categories.update`, `banners.create`, `banners.update`, `brands.create`, `brands.update`, `settings.update`

Select up to 10 images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF; max 5MB each). The real file content is checked, not just the extension. Put the returned URLs in `thumbnail`, `gallery` or category `imageUrl`.

Without Cloudinary settings in `.env`, images are saved in the server's `/uploads` folder (development only).

**Permission:** `categories.create`

Name must be unique (case-insensitive). Slug is auto-generated if empty. The parent must exist and be ACTIVE.

get.summary: List categories (flat with path, or nested tree)
get.description:
**Permission:** `categories.view`

For the product form dropdown use `?status=ACTIVE` (or `GET /api/products/options`).

parameters.name: parentId
parameters.description: Parent category ID, or "null" for root categories

get.summary: Get a category with parent, children, breadcrumb and counts
get.description: **Permission:** `categories.view`

put.description:
**Permission:** `categories.update`

A category cannot be its own parent or be moved under one of its own sub-categories (circular). A new parent must be ACTIVE. Max 5 levels deep.

delete.description:
**Permission:** `categories.delete`

Fails with 409 if the category has sub-categories or products.

example.message: Category cannot be deleted because it contains products or sub-categories

patch.description:
**Permission:** `categories.update`

Inactive categories are hidden from the storefront and the product dropdown, and cannot get new products. A category cannot be activated while its parent is inactive.

get.summary: Add/Edit Product form options (category dropdown, sizes, units)
get.description:
**Permission:** `products.create` or `products.update`

`categories` contains only ACTIVE categories (whose parents are also active).

post.description:
**Permission:** `products.create`

Rules: category must exist and be ACTIVE (send `categoryId`, not a name) · stock is a whole number >= 0 · `customerSpecialPrice <= customerSellPrice` · `unit` and `quantity` go together · fabric products (`isFabric: true`) need sizes or unit+quantity · sizes are dropped for non-fabric products · thumbnail required.

get.description:
**Login optional.** Guests and customers see only ACTIVE products in ACTIVE categories, with `availability` (IN_STOCK / OUT_OF_STOCK) and never the stock number or cost.

Logged-in staff see more:
- `stock` with `inventory.view`
- `productCost` and INACTIVE products with `products.update`

get.summary: Get a product by ID or slug (works without login)
get.description: **Login optional.** `id` can be the product ID or its slug (e.g. `premium-cotton-t-shirt`). Same visibility rules as the list.

put.description:
**Permission:** `products.update` (+ `inventory.update` to change stock)

A new category must be ACTIVE. Price rules are checked against the final values.

delete.description:
**Permission:** `products.delete`

If the product appears in any order it is set to INACTIVE instead of being deleted (order history stays intact). `data.deleted` tells which happened.

200.description: Deleted, or deactivated if the product has orders

deleted.description: false = product had orders and was set INACTIVE instead

patch.description:
**Permission:** `products.update`

Inactive products are hidden from customers and cannot be ordered. Cannot activate while the product's category is inactive.

**Permission:** `inventory.update`

Send `{ "stock": 50 }` to set a value, or `{ "adjustBy": -3 }` / `{ "adjustBy": 10 }` to change it. Stock can never go below 0.

**Permission:** `products.update`

Max 10 gallery images. To replace the whole gallery, send `gallery` in PUT instead.

get.description: No login. Inactive categories and everything under them are hidden.
No login. Only ACTIVE products in ACTIVE categories. Shows `availability` (IN_STOCK / OUT_OF_STOCK), never the stock number or cost.
No login. Returns 404 for inactive products or products in inactive categories.

**Permission:** `cart.manage`

Prices are refreshed from the current products. Items that can no longer be ordered have `isAvailable: false` and an `issue`.

post.description:
**Permission:** `cart.manage`

Checks: product exists, ACTIVE, category ACTIVE, in stock, quantity valid (1-50), size valid (required if the product has sizes), unit valid. The same product + size is merged into one line. Returns the full cart.

put.summary: Change quantity and/or size of a cart item

delete.summary: Remove an item from my cart

post.description:
**Permission:** `orders.create`

Validates the cart (products, categories, prices, stock), shipping info and payment method, then returns the order summary with totals calculated by the backend. Call `POST /api/orders` with the same body to place the order.

post.summary: Place an order from my cart
post.description:
**Permission:** `orders.create`

Runs in one database transaction: validate → create order + items → reduce stock → clear cart. If anything fails (e.g. another customer bought the last items), everything is rolled back and the cart is kept.

Errors: `400` invalid input / empty cart / product unavailable, `409` `Insufficient product stock` or the cart changed during checkout.

409.description: Stock ran out during checkout, or the cart changed

example.message: Insufficient product stock

get.description: **Permission:** `orders.view` (only your own orders)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Order ID or order number (e.g. ORD-1001)

get.description:
**Permission:** `orders.view`

Another customer's order returns 404.

patch.description:
**Permission:** `orders.create` (own orders only)

Allowed while the order is PENDING, CONFIRMED or PROCESSING. Stock is restored exactly once (cancelling again is rejected).

get.description:
**Permission:** `orders.viewAll`

All filters can be combined, e.g. `?status=PENDING&paymentStatus=PAID&fromDate=2026-01-01&toDate=2026-01-31&page=1&limit=20`. Dates are Bangladesh time.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Order number, customer name, phone, or email

get.summary: Order details (with customer account and allowed next statuses)
get.description: **Permission:** `orders.viewAll`

patch.description:
**Permission:** `orders.status`

Flow: PENDING → CONFIRMED → PROCESSING → SHIPPED → DELIVERED. CANCELLED is allowed from PENDING, CONFIRMED or PROCESSING (stock is restored). Any other change is rejected. Logs `ORDER_<STATUS>`.

patch.summary: Update payment status (separate from order status)
patch.description:
**Permission:** `orders.paymentStatus`

Allowed: PENDING → PAID or FAILED · FAILED → PENDING or PAID · PAID → REFUNDED. REFUNDED is final. Logs `PAYMENT_STATUS_CHANGED`.

get.summary: List all banners (active and inactive) in display order
get.description: **Permission:** `banners.view`

parameters.name: placement
parameters.description: HERO = big banner, PROMO = promo cards

post.summary: Create a big banner (HERO) or a promo card (PROMO)
post.description:
**Permission:** `banners.create`

Upload the image first with `POST /api/uploads/images?folder=banners`, then send its URL. Only imageUrl is required; placement defaults to HERO.

Only **2 promo cards** can be ACTIVE at once (409 otherwise). Save extra ones as INACTIVE and switch later.

patch.summary: Set the display order of banners
patch.description:
**Permission:** `banners.update`

Send banner IDs in the order they should appear (first shows first). Order big banners and promo cards separately (400 if mixed).

get.description: **Permission:** `banners.view`

put.description:
**Permission:** `banners.update`

Send only the fields to change. `""` clears a text field. The image can be replaced but not removed.

Activating a promo card (or moving a banner to PROMO) fails with 409 when 2 promo cards are already active.

patch.description:
**Permission:** `banners.update`

INACTIVE banners are hidden from the website.

Activating a promo card (or moving a banner to PROMO) fails with 409 when 2 promo cards are already active.

get.description: **Permission:** `brands.view`

parameters.name: featured
parameters.description: Only brands shown / not shown in Top Brands

post.summary: Add a brand (name and logo are required)
post.description:
**Permission:** `brands.create`

Upload the logo first with `POST /api/uploads/images?folder=brands`. Names are unique (case-insensitive).

get.description: **Permission:** `brands.view`

put.description:
**Permission:** `brands.update`

Send only the fields to change. Renaming keeps the slug unless a new slug is sent. The logo can be replaced but not removed.

get.description:
**Permission:** `settings.view`

All fields are always present (empty strings / empty arrays until set).

put.description:
**Permission:** `settings.update`

Everything is optional. Send only the parts to change; the rest is kept. For example `{ "contact": { "phone": "01811111111" } }` changes only the phone.

- `""` clears a field
- `columns` replaces all columns (max 6 columns, 12 links each)
- Social networks: facebook, instagram, youtube, tiktok, twitter, linkedin, whatsapp

get.summary: Active big banners and promo cards for the landing page
get.description: No login. Call with ?placement=HERO for the big banner/slider and ?placement=PROMO for the promo cards (max 2). Without the filter both are returned, each with its placement.

parameters.name: placement
parameters.description: HERO = big banner, PROMO = promo cards

get.description: No login. Use `?featured=true` for the Top Brands section.
No login.

post.description: Any logged-in user. Send exactly one image in the `images` field (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF; max 5MB). It is saved to your profile right away.

get.summary: Sales totals: today, yesterday, 7/14/30 days, 6 months, 1 year
get.description:
**Permission:** `sales.view`

Counts **DELIVERED** orders (refunded ones excluded) on the day they were delivered, in Bangladesh time. `amount` = products + shipping - discount.

Periods include today: last 7 days = today + 6 days before. 1 month = 30 days, 6 months = 180 days, 1 year = 365 days.

`ordersByStatus` = how many orders are in each status right now.

get.summary: Sales chart data (per day or per month)
get.description:
**Permission:** `sales.view`

`7d`, `14d`, `30d` give one point per day; `6m`, `1y` give one point per month. Days/months without sales are included with 0.

get.summary: Payments received and refunded per period
get.description:
**Permission:** `payments.view`

`received` = orders with payment status PAID (by the day they were marked paid). `refunded` = REFUNDED orders. `outstanding` = money not collected yet (unpaid orders that are not cancelled), split by payment method.
